verdict.rationale: Reducto Studio is a web UI where you configure classification, parsing and extraction steps and test them on real documents with a citation viewer, before deploying a Pipeline ID you call from code (reducto-docs-34, reducto-docs-59). It is included on the free tier with up to 5 seats (reducto-docs-60), and community users describe its UX positively (reducto-comm-8). One launch-time report of a broken Studio link (reducto-comm-3) concerns access, not the capability, so it lowers confidence rather than the verdict. missing for 10: explicit documentation of drag-and-drop upload and of the result-viewing experience (parse JSON/markdown preview), hands-on independent corroboration of the playground flow.
